summary: User directs independent batch execution without a running Web dependency; Web selects database through startup configuration and retains it for process lifetime. Prior online Web bootstrap/grant/current-authority transport assumptions require bounded plan correction.

user_sources.text: I find a severe gap between me and current batch plan. What I want is batch can run independently, while web app use different database by changing its config when startup. Not a runtime switch, run as current plan says.
correction agreed. Go back to plan phase and proceed run-governed-delivery with my arrangements.
